issues.desc: background.md Operator Impact section uses "Plan B" ("Plan B's retry only covers TIMEOUTs, never FAILs") without defining the term. B-2941 is described as "two-pass retry" in the Trigger Event section, but "Plan B" as an alias is never introduced. A new reader cannot infer which mechanism or story "Plan B" refers to.

index.json has priority: "P2", which is non-standard. Lattice workflow-policy.ts and gate logic check story.priority === 'high' | 'critical'; "P2" will not match, so high-risk gates (decision gate, preMortem ≥3) will silently not trigger even if the operator intended this to be high-priority. Standard values are high / medium / low / critical.

background.md Conversational Texture mentions B-be91 and B-c6cf ("--jobs default (B-be91 falsified); test:coverage (B-c6cf frozen)") without any one-sentence explanation of what these stories are or why they are out of scope. A new reader has no context for these identifiers.
